title: BOM is ready for resin mixing work order
Purchase Receipt has raw material stock for manufacturing
Work Order is created from BOM and submitted
Job Card is created from Work Order with required items
Material Transfer for Manufacture transfers raw materials to WIP
Job Card > Cancel Material Transfer for Manufacture and Redo with Same Stock
Manufacture Stock Entry records scale-based raw material value and process loss
Entity sticker can be generated for manufactured resin entity
Job Card > Cancel Posted Manufacture Entry and Redo
